root_cause: Netlify production executed the full bilingual SEO build pipeline while the GitHub website build-parity lane still ran the older shorter pipeline. A production-only failure could therefore merge without the exact build command having been proven in CI.
prevention: Website premerge build parity must execute the same SEO-order, locale, revenue-link, sitemap and locale-validation stages as Netlify production.
Changes to the production build command update the website parity workflow and its Brain regression in the same lineage.
Production promotion is retriggered only after exact build parity is green.
fix: Extend the website lane production-build-parity sequence to the exact bilingual SEO Netlify stages and add a Brain regression that enforces their order.
